build_MatcherCustomOp: build a matcher custom op class to abstract custom and native forward implementations for pattern matching
create_MatcherRotaryEmbedding: create a matcher rotary embedding instance with neox mode, head size, and number of heads for fused attention pattern matching
build_MatcherFusedAddRMSNorm: build a fused add RMS norm matcher with epsilon and optional ROCm aiter support for layer norm fusion patterns
create_MatcherQuantFP8: create an FP8 quantization matcher with quant key, group shape, and ROCm aiter support for quant fusion patterns
build_MatcherSiluAndMul: build a silu and mul matcher to fuse activation and multiplication operations in transformer layers
